name: GM - Saginaw Metal Casting Operations, Saginaw MI

fieldNotes.facility: GM Saginaw Metal Casting Operations (SMCO), 1629 N Washington Ave, Saginaw MI. Aluminum foundry: precision sand + semi-permanent mold casting of V6 engine blocks, cylinder heads and 4WD front-axle castings, plus pre/final machining; ~1.9M sq ft, historically on a ~490-acre land parcel but the active fenced manufacturing footprint is far smaller (~110 acres). Coords re-pinned from the roster address point to the true plant core at 43.4489,-83.9190 via Wikipedia (43.4529,-83.9159) cross-checked against satellite identification of the large multi-building foundry mass on the east bank of the Saginaw River with a flanking rail spur. Confirmed = the correct GM industrial building.
fieldNotes.site: Active foundry that has been heavily downsized: large areas of the parcel are now vacant cracked-concrete former-building footprints (clear demolition scars E and SE of the core) and open laydown yard. The remaining production mass is a dense cluster of connected foundry buildings (6+ distinct roof sections) center-right of the parcel.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled fenced campus. Continuous chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in 2023/2024 Street View along the N Washington Ave / west and south frontage (fence + employee picnic pavilion visible inside the line). Primary controlled access is a divided boulevard drive off N Washington at ~43.4466,-83.9180; an open public truck gate is not present - access is through the secured campus drive. truckGate=true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively resolved at the entrance in available imagery; the divided entry drive feeds the secured interior. Marked uncertain. Set guardShack=false / remoteGs=true (gate present, no clearly staffed booth visible -> implies kiosk/badge/app check-in), flagged for human review.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved interior yards inside the fence (former demolished footprints now open pavement, plus the central laydown apron) give ample post-gate holding before the docks; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach from the Washington Ave entry drive through the interior road network to the dock/laydown courts - easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 10-25 band, estimated ~14. Foundry truck docks are modest and distributed on the interior building faces (sand/alloy inbound, finished-casting outbound); much material moves by rail rather than truck, so exterior dock count is low for a plant this size. Low-confidence overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 10-25. Trailers and containers visible parked in the north/northeast laydown yard (~8 trailers visible) with room for ~40; classified as a drop yard. dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer/container storage and material laydown in the open paved yard north and northeast of the building core, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs diagonally (NW-SE) directly alongside the plant's west face into the property (visible dark linear feature with material-handling/silo structures and an electrical substation at the NW corner). Foundries of this type receive bulk material and ship by rail. railServed=true, high confidence.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Could not confirm physically separate shipping vs receiving dock clusters; ship/rcv likely share interior dock courts. Set false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single integrated foundry complex (one building cluster), not a multi-building campus of separate plants; multipleFacilities=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the City of Saginaw - residential neighborhoods abut the south and west frontage across N Washington Ave; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane counts (1/1) are overhead estimates of the entry boulevard, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.streetView: Public Street View coverage exists on N Washington Ave at the SW frontage (pano uLQq0M9x0QJFyrcATSzZWQ @ 43.44622,-83.91826, captured 2023-05) and shows the perimeter fence; no pano inside the secured campus, so both zone panos point from this frontage pano toward the gate/perimeter.
